scope: Counterexamples apply to the exact statements and conventions identified by the paper audit. They do not invalidate every result or implementation in those papers.

counterexamples.claim: PFP011 sign cancellation from swapping N_plus and N_minus
counterexamples.conclusion: Swapping negates the integer exponent and preserves parity; it does not produce cancellation.

counterexamples.claim: non-PFP004 zero diamond branch difference iff declared diamond flatness
counterexamples.conclusion: Equal path products do not imply equality to the supplied direct restriction map.

counterexamples.claim: non-PFP002 dual support must lie on primal residual support
counterexamples.conclusion: Optimal dual coordinates can be nonzero on edges with zero residual.

counterexamples.claim: PFP017 arbitrary oriented tree reduced incidence inverse has only 0/1 entries
counterexamples.conclusion: Reversing an edge introduces a negative sign; entries are not restricted to 0/1.
